facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT says the sovereign cloud RFI document may be downloaded from the Public Procurement Portal (publicprocurement.govmu.org), which publishes government procurement documents online.

MUS.note: Sovereign cloud is a request for information only; no data centre in service stated.
Data residency is an objective of the planned sovereign cloud; no rule stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT issued RFI MITCI/RFI/01/2025-26 to suppliers to implement a Sovereign Cloud for the Government of Mauritius, governed by Mauritian law, covering data residency and privacy.
